properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with a low pressure area  located about 350 miles east of Bermuda have changed little in  organization during the past several hours.  Environmental  conditions could support gradual development of the system during  the next day or two, and a tropical depression could form during  that time. The system is forecast to move slowly today, and then  possibly turn southward on Friday over the subtropical Atlantic. By  Sunday, environmental conditions are forecast to become less  favorable for development. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.

Another tropical wave is producing disorganized showers and  thunderstorms several hundred miles south of southwestern Mexico.  Environmental conditions also appear conducive for gradual  development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to  form late this weekend or early next week while it moves gradually  northwestward turning northward off the coast of southwestern  Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

A tropical wave continues to produce disorganized showers and  thunderstorms well to the south-southwest of the southern tip of the  Baja California Peninsula. Environmental conditions appear  conducive for gradual development of this system, and a tropical  depression is likely to form this weekend or early next week as it  moves westward at 10 to 15 mph across the western part of the East  Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms have increased somewhat with an area of  low pressure related to the remnants of Tropical Depression  Fifteen-E. Environmental conditions appear only marginally conducive  for some development of this system as it moves gradually westward,  remaining east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.
